理由: 句中误用大写 And，应为小写 and

原: coming back to life. thanks to help
改为: coming back to life, thanks to help
理由: 一句被句号切成两半，thanks 小写开头，应与上句合并
地名拼写与下一句 Mahmudia 不一致，正确拼写为 Mahmudia（罗马尼亚马胡迪亚）

原: to restore the waterways, Government officials
改为: to restore the waterways. Government officials
理由: 两句连在一起漏了句号（Government 大写开头，另起一句）
校名拼写错误：美国宾夕法尼亚州 East Juniata High School

原: Scott’s name was called only Scott’s name.
改为: Scott’s name was called, only Scott’s name.

原: I found the same thing. so lately
改为: I found the same thing, so lately
理由: 一句被句号切成两半，so 小写开头，应与上句合并

原: short span of time, Prospective employers
改为: short span of time, prospective employers

原: experience in different jobs. and in different industries.
改为: experience in different jobs and in different industries.
理由: 一句被句号切成两半，and 小写开头，应与上句合并

原: even if she got promoted? In her current company.
改为: even if she got promoted in her current company?
理由: 题目被问号切成两半，In her current company 是同一问句的一部分

原: can actually be a blessing. particularly
改为: can actually be a blessing, particularly
理由: 一句被句号切成两半，particularly 小写开头，应与上句合并
一句被句号切成两半，and 小写开头，应与上句合并

原: memory loss in older people. a new study
改为: memory loss in older people, a new study
理由: 一句被句号切成两半，a 小写开头，应与上句合并
两句连在一起漏了句号（Scientists 大写开头，另起一句）

原: about their finding? concerning the link
改为: about their finding concerning the link
理由: 题目被问号切成两半，concerning 小写开头，问号应移到下一句句末
